messages:
Noah: heads-up: p99 for /v1/stream on the endpoints percentile pane spiked ~60% at 03:45 UTC. p50/p95 unchanged. looks like tail-only. Filters: region=ap-southeast, model=redwood-13b.
Priya: which Console view? endpoints percentiles rollup? can you paste the exact link?
Noah: Observability -> Latency -> Endpoints (rollup) window 03:40-03:50. link: https://console/redwood/latency?endpoint=%2Fv1%2Fstream&region=ap-southeast
Ibrahim: quick thought: we compute percentiles by merging t-digests from telemetry shards. that math is correct but there are edge-cases when the tdigest "compression" parameter or merge-version changes between deployments which can shift tails. did we ship any telemetry changes recently?
Jules: telemetry-release v2.11 rolled last night at 02:20 UTC (sha: ff3344). it changed default tdigest_compression from 100 to 200 to reduce memory. that can subtly reduce apparent tails when t-digests are merged.
Noah: ah interesting. that would move p99 downward normally, not upward. so why spike up?
Priya: two possibilities: 1) a small subset of requests fell back to pool:legacy-warm (we saw quota_fallbacks around 03:43); 2) mixed-merge of tdigests with different compression/versions can create artifacts if some shards used old compression and others new and the algorithm combines raw centroids differently.
Ibrahim: plus sampling-rate changes matter. some proxies sampled 1/5 for that minute due to debug flags. higher sampling on slow-origin exaggerates tails. we need to show sampling_fraction and telemetry_merge_version in the UI.
Noah: proposal (new): surface three small pieces in the endpoints percentile hover: total_sample_count, top-2 sample_origins with percentages, and telemetry_merge_version/tdigest_compression used for the merged result. also show a tiny ? tooltip: "If merge_version or compression varies across shards, tails may be unstable; click 'recompute' to rerun the query forcing consistent compression."
Jules: we could add a backend endpoint to recompute percentiles on-demand by fetching raw samples for the window (only for small windows) to validate the merged tdigest result. call it "recompute-with-raw" and gate it behind perms. very useful for forensics.
Priya: I like that. short-term: add sample_count + top-origin badges + merge_version field to hover. medium-term: add the recompute-with-raw action.
ops-bot: telemetry-service v2.11 deployed by @deploy-bot at 2026-04-12T02:20:00Z (sha: ff3344) :gear:
Ibrahim: action items: Jules to add merge_version and compression metadata to tdigest rollups (PR), Priya to wire UI hover to display it, Noah to run raw-sample recompute for 03:40-03:50 and post results.
Noah: will run recompute and post numbers. if recompute matches merged p99 then it's a real tail; if not, it's a merge artifact and we can mark the dashboard as noisy for that window.
Priya: also updating alert rules: suppress endpoint p99 alerts when merge_version variance > 0 across shards or when total_sample_count < 50. That should cut false positives.
Noah: thanks all. this feels distinct from the usual "show sample_count" convo because the tdigest merge-version angle could explain unexplained inversions. I'll ping CS if customers ask. closing when PRs land and recompute completes. :thumbsup:
